description: This file contains the PHP class 'Modification' within the OpenCart administrative marketplace namespace. It manages marketplace modifications, including listing, refreshing, and deleting modifications and their associated XML files. The class extends the core Controller and interacts with models for modifications and settings, handles permissions, and generates views with data for the admin interface.

classes.name: Modification
classes.description: Controller class for managing marketplace modifications within the admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language, sets page title, parses URL parameters, prepares data array, and renders the modification view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX request to display the list of modifications with pagination and sorting.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Fetches and returns a list of modifications based on filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes modifications by reloading XML files, updating the database, and invalidating cache if permissions are sufficient.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Reads and returns the contents of the 'ocmod.log' log file.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all modifications, deletes files/directories, and resets settings, with permission checks.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables a specific modification, identified by modification ID, and returns a JSON success or error message.

methods.name: disable
methods.description: Disables a specific modification by modification ID, with permission validation, and returns a JSON response.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected modifications based on POST data, with permission validation, returning a JSON response.
